detail.longDescription:
Hi, it's been a while! 👋

I've been building Spectacled: lightweight 📓 Journals, 🗒️ Notes and ✅ Tasks apps, synced over CalDAV with your own server, on Android, iOS, desktop and web. Open source.

jtx Board isn't going anywhere and stays the full-featured app. Spectacled is its simpler sibling for every platform.

A public beta starts in a few days! Follow @spectacled@mastodon.social so you don't miss it.

Boosts very welcome 🙏

#jtxBoard #CalDAV #Nextcloud #OpenSource #Android #iOS
